description: A false-colour satellite image depicting a complex coastal and estuarine landscape. The deep blue expanse on the left represents a sea or ocean, bordered by white, wavy patterns likely indicating sandy dunes or coastal barrier formations. A prominent light blue/cyan river or channel meanders through the landscape, opening into the larger water body at the bottom left. Adjacent to the river and further inland are extensive reddish-brown areas, which in false colour typically represent vegetated land, possibly agricultural fields or specific natural vegetation types. Towards the upper right, large, geometrically structured blue rectangular areas are visible, suggestive of aquaculture ponds or salines. A cluster of light pink/white features in the bottom left indicates an urban or developed area. A bright yellow arrow points to an irregular, brownish-greenish area in the upper-central part of the image, within the estuarine system, which represents a salt marsh (Copernicus Land Monitoring Service land cover class 7.2.1), an area of vegetated beds and muddy flats influenced by tidal water.
